title: Short-exact devissage with constructible outer terms
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ a curve [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], and $\Lambda$ any commutative ring. Let $0\to F_1\to F\to F_3\to0$ be short exact in the category of $\Lambda$-module sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{\acute et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], with both outer terms constructible [def-constructible-constructible]. If the eight conditional curve assertions [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions] hold for both outer terms, then they hold for $F$. No Noetherian-ring or algebraically closed-field hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Lemma 0A5C; proof specialized from Curve.Reductions.Assertions.of_shortExact with constructible outer terms

proof.text: Use Etale.shortExact_map_forget2 to pass to underlying abelian sheaves. Exact geometric stalks show that primary and invertible-order torsion of the middle term pass to the outer terms. Their constructibility is an explicit hypothesis, so the Noetherian subobject argument is not needed.

For C1-C3 the exact cohomology segment has zero outer groups; lift a middle class to the first term and conclude it is zero. For C4-C5 apply ShortComplex.Exact.ab_finite to the exact cohomology segment.

For C6-C7 use the natural long exact ladder. Injectivity and surjectivity of the middle comparison are proved by lifting through the third and first terms and removing boundaries; degree zero uses the initial injective map.

For C8, H3 of the first term is zero by C1. Lift the third-term image across restriction and across the short exact sequence, then correct the residual difference through the first term by C8. Assemble all eight fields.
